title: Feature gates & SDK rollout plan for telemetry schema v2 compatibility
creator: Aisha Mahajan
description: Motivation: we need a safe, observable, and low-risk path to introduce telemetry schema v2 across SDK, CLI, and API layers without dropping events or breaking downstream analytics. This ticket scopes the runtime feature-gates, gateway shim, SDK header negotiation, and the pipeline transformation/backfill approach. Goals: (1) allow mixed v1/v2 producers during rollout, (2) provide an opt-in feature gate per-tenant for accelerated rollout, (3) expose a preflight validation endpoint for SDK/CLI to test compatibility, (4) implement lightweight gateway compat shim to translate v1 envelopes to v2 when needed, and (5) add analytics and alerting to detect dropped fields, sample skews, and transformation errors.
acceptance_criteria: SDK and CLI can opt-in to emit X-Redwood-Telemetry-Version: 2 header and receive 200 preflight response from /telemetry/preflight
Gateway shim correctly translates core envelope (timestamp, tenant_id, event_type, payload) from v1->v2 for at least 95% of events in end-to-end tests
Observability: dashboard shows per-tenant v1/v2 ratio, event loss rate <0.1%, and transformation error rate <0.01% within first 48h of rollout
Canary rollout plan defined with automated rollback if transformation error rate >0.5% or customer-impacting alerts fire
Contract tests added to CI: SDK/CLI integration tests exercising preflight, header negotiation, and a simulated v1->v2 gateway translation
implementation_notes: Add X-Redwood-Telemetry-Version header negotiation in SDK (js/py) and CLI agent; default remains v1 unless feature gate enabled
Implement /telemetry/preflight endpoint in console-backend that validates payload shape and returns a vector of supported optional fields and max payload size
Gateway shim: stateless translation layer implemented as a middleware in api-gateway; prefer explicit field mappings and a small transformation map file for fast lookups
Analytics pipeline: avoid in-place mutation of raw events. Instead, write transformed v2 records to a v2 topic and add metadata fields: original_version, transform_status, transform_errors
Backfill approach: for historical v1 events we will run a batch transformer into v2 topics for query parity; schedule separate job (offline) to limit resource contention
Sampling & feature gates: implement per-tenant gates with default off; support percentage rollouts and allow overrides via console for customer support
Testing: add contract harness that signs synthetic events and verifies schema compatibility using jsonschema validators; test vectors stored in repo under telemetry/test_vectors
migration_plan: Phase 0 - Prep (this ticket): preflight endpoint, gateway shim, analytics pipeline instrumentation, contract tests
Phase 1 - Internal Canary: enable v2 on internal tenants and 1% external traffic; monitor dashboard for 72h
Phase 2 - Customer Opt-in: console toggle to opt-in tenants; provide CLI flag --telemetry-version=2 and SDK config option
Phase 3 - Progressive Rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with gating rules and automated rollback
Phase 4 - Backfill: run offline transformer on historical v1 topic and run side-by-side comparison queries to validate parity
Phase 5 - Deprecation: announce v1 deprecation after 90 days of 100% v2 adoption per-tenant; keep gateway shim for 180 days post-deprecation
comments: 2025-02-16 - Aisha Mahajan: Kickoff notes: aligned with Analytics team on required v2 fields. Raised question about whether to include user_agent parsing in gateway or rely on downstream enrichment. Analytics prefers downstream enrichment to keep gateway lightweight.

2025-02-20 - Rafael Gomez (Analytics): Analytics concern: transformation errors will skew dashboards if we mutate in-flight. We must add transform_status metadata and keep raw events immutable. Agreed to write v2 to a separate topic.

2025-02-24 - Priya Singh (Product): PM note: Need a clear opt-in UX and support playbook for customers who opt-in and see regressions. Also request a console banner that shows opt-in status and last transform error time.

2025-02-28 - Code review by Eng Backend: Suggested adding circuit breaker in gateway shim to stop translations if transform latency > 200ms; otherwise risk increasing P50 latency for inference calls that use same gateway cluster.

2025-03-03 - Liam O'Connor: Implemented preflight endpoint prototype (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/3872). Putting up integration test tomorrow. Noted: CLI preflight uses 2s timeout and retries once; SDK will adopt same behavior.
